# Dofrane Acquisitions

> Maryland real estate cash buyer. Written cash offers on Maryland houses as they stand.

Dofrane Acquisitions makes written cash offers on houses in Maryland, in their current condition. A seller gives the property address and a few facts about the house; a person reviews it and calls back within one business day with next steps. There is no repair demand, no agent commission charged to the seller, and no showings. The seller is never obliged to accept an offer.

Service area: Maryland only, with a focus on Baltimore City, Baltimore County, Anne Arundel County, Howard County, Prince George's County and Montgomery County. Offers are not made on property outside Maryland.

Dofrane Acquisitions is a real estate investor, not a real estate brokerage, and does not act as the seller's agent. Every offer is in writing. Consent to be contacted is collected on the form and recorded.
